posts.name: WTFGamer
posts.cooked:
I went to BGG Con hoping to see the new Sentinels Tactics game there. I talked with a guy (his name started with "N" and was non-standard like Nich or something) on the last day and picked up a copy of Schlock Mercenary: Capital Offensive since the combat system is similar. He said there was a Beta Team sign up on the >G site. I've poked around but haven't found it yet. I love what I've seen so far and I'm eager to give the system a try. I've done game testing before and know how to provide clear, constructive feedback. Can anyone point me in the proper direction?

-Chris
